name: git-hex-abortOperation
description: Abort a paused rebase/merge/cherry-pick and restore original state. When to use: when you cannot or do not want to resolve conflicts, or when you want to try a different approach. Do NOT use if you want to preserve partial progress - this discards ALL changes made during the operation. Use undoLast instead if the operation already completed.

repoPath.description: Path to git repository (optional; defaults to the single configured root if omitted)
